scope: Local source, unit, static migration, fresh/populated PostgreSQL 17.10, restricted-role, previous-release upgrade, production-build, secret-scan, and dependency evidence for bounded repair of synthetic pre-classifier source receipts. No customer data, provider credential/request, source-system write, hosted database, protected staging, production deployment, mixed-image rollout, representative volume, legal decision, or production-readiness claim is included.

priorEvidence.relationship: Extends the prior immutable 51-migration database evidence with migration 0051, a dedicated maintenance role, the bounded repair implementation, and final 52-migration verification. It supersedes only that artifact's bounded populated classification-repair blocker.

runtime.authentication: trust on the loopback-only temporary synthetic cluster

repairContract.candidateLock: FOR UPDATE OF source_events SKIP LOCKED

databaseSuite.command: CI=true pnpm exec vitest run --project integration packages/database/src

repairSuite.command: CI=true pnpm exec vitest run --project integration apps/worker/src/source-event-classification-repair.integration.test.ts

syntheticFinalState.reasonForRemainingGap: The test deliberately inserts one unsupported Shopify operational topic to prove it remains visible and blocks completion.

coveredAssertions: two independent maintenance sessions pass a two-read barrier and claim distinct locked candidates
Shopify order and Stripe refund classifications are exact
classification and audit are visible only in the correct tenant
audit version-2 event hash recomputes exactly
application and worker cannot execute maintenance repair functions
maintenance cannot directly read or write source, classification, or audit tables
maintenance is non-superuser, non-createdb, non-createrole, non-inheriting, and non-bypass
missing object rolls back classification and audit
exact replay appends no duplicate classification or audit
unsupported topic is excluded from repair claims but remains in total gap count
populated previous-release upgrade applies migration 0051 and preserves membership and audit evidence

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: The first live gap-count attempt overcounted repaired rows because the non-bypass security-definer owner could not see classification rows under forced RLS without tenant context.
verificationCorrections.correction: Add a migrator-only SELECT policy on the append-only classification table for the fixed repair functions; maintenance still has no table privilege.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: The live concurrent and retry/replay suite passed.

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: The initial repository design required generic maintenance SELECT/INSERT authority on audit_events to call the standard TypeScript audit writer.
verificationCorrections.correction: Move audit-head preparation and the fixed repair-audit insert behind security-definer functions and revoke every direct audit-table privilege from maintenance.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: Direct audit SELECT is denied and the inserted version-2 hash recomputes exactly.

verificationCorrections.problemObserved: The S3 verified-read path had byte and digest limits but no explicit response deadline while a repair held the source-row lock.
verificationCorrections.correction: Add a validated optional S3 verified-read timeout, abort request and stream reads, use 15 seconds in repair, and classify timeout distinctly.
verificationCorrections.postCorrectionResult: A local hanging HTTP endpoint is aborted and the repair maps timeout to SOURCE_OBJECT_READ_TIMEOUT.
